answer_3.quote: Prompting large language models (LLMs) in zero and few-shot settings.

answer_4.quote: We trained native speakers and recruited them as annotators. For each language, we also recruited a native speaker as a language lead who would control for the quality of the annotations.
answer_4.guideline: We provided the annotators with thorough guidelines (see Figure in the Appendix). We asked the annotators to choose one of three categories: hate, abusive/offensive, or neutral.
criteria: target attributes: ethnicity, politics, gender, disability, religion, or other
